text:
maya (partnerships): Starting a focused thread for the acceptance criteria we need to hit MVP for AWS/GCP/Azure marketplace listings. Please keep replies short so we can copy into the runbook. Key areas: offer provisioning, entitlement lifecycle, trial UX, telemetry consent, and infra creds.
oren (cloud-eng): Technical acceptance: 1) Fulfillment webhook implemented for SNS / PubSub / Event Grid; 2) HMAC verification + replay window; 3) Idempotent processing (idempotency_key on payload). I'll own point 1-3.
zara (product): Product acceptance: 1) Single listing with plan SKUs (trial/standard/dedicated); 2) Entitlement payload must include plan_id, feature_flags, region, and optional callback_url; 3) Default trial TTL = 14d, extension via manual opt-in. I'll produce sample payloads.
maria (legal): Legal acceptance: 1) EU telemetry opt-in language in listing and checkout; 2) Private-offer addendum template; 3) Retention windows surfaced (default 90d, customer can request longer under contract). I can draft redlines.
callum (solutions): Partner acceptance: 1) Reseller provisioning token flow (CLI + short-lived token API); 2) Conversion callback support so SIs get provisioning events; 3) Example reseller docs for onboarding. I'll prototype the CLI.
integration-bot: IntegrationBot: staging-project created, topics and test webhooks provisioned (test-run=acceptance-mvp-2026-03-23).
maya (partnerships): Ops acceptance: creds rotation runbook + KMS templates for all three clouds. Deepa from cloud-ops suggested cross-account role for AWS, SP for Azure, SA for GCP. Who owns runbook?
oren (cloud-eng): I'll write the infra templates: AWS role + external id, KMS key policy snippet, GCP service account IAM snippet, Azure SP + role assignment example. Put them under repo/marketplace/integration/examples.
zara (product): UX acceptance: the marketplace trial flow must show clear telemetry consent if in EU, and the in-app trial activation must map to entitlement_code. Also want a conversion CTA for customers to upgrade from trial.
maria (legal): Also need to confirm what billing metadata the clouds expose on private offers (Azure historically did not surface partner billing ids for some plans). Partnerships: can you chase Azure rep?
maya (partnerships): On it. Action owners recap: oren -> webhook adapters + infra snippets; zara -> entitlement spec + sample payloads; callum -> reseller CLI + callback examples; maria -> legal redlines + telemetry wording; maya -> Azure billing confirm + runbook collate. Weekly sync Friday 9am PT.
oren (cloud-eng): Quick terraform snippet for AWS role (staging):
```terraform
resource "aws_iam_role" "marketplace_integration" {
  name = "redwood-marketplace-int-staging"
  assume_role_policy = jsonencode({
    Version = "2012-10-17",
    Statement = [{
      Effect = "Allow",
      Principal = { AWS = "arn:aws:iam::MARKETPLACE_ACCOUNT:root" },
      Action = "sts:AssumeRole",
      Condition = { StringEquals = { "sts:ExternalId" = var.external_id } }
    }]
  })
}
```
callum (solutions): Reseller CLI idea: `rw-market mk-token --org acme --ttl 72h --scopes onboarding`. Token is single-use by default. Will wire a sample web flow for resellers.
zara (product): Sample entitlement payload I will share in the doc: {offer_id, plan_id, customer_id, entitlement_code, start_ts, expires_ts, features, callback_url}. We'll require hmac header.
maria (legal): :thumbsup: Make sure product surfaces the telemetry opt-in boolean for EU customers and that we log consent timestamp.
maya (partnerships): Blockers? If none, we will draft the runbook doc and owners will add PRs by Wednesday.
oren (cloud-eng): Blocker: need a billing account id for GCP staging to test procurement API.
maya (partnerships): I'll follow up with finance and cloud reps.
callum (solutions): Blocker: want a short example of partner callback security expectations (signed JWT?). Will draft recommendation.
maria (legal): No blockers on legal side aside from Azure billing exposure confirmation.
integration-bot: IntegrationBot: scheduled smoke-run acceptance-mvp-2026-03-25 03:00 PT. Results to #ci-results.
